archetypes.name: Product post — vendor lockup over centred text stack, product photo below
archetypes.description: Gradient navy-to-light field. Vendor wordmark, product name, AVAILABLE, @, stick logo, CTA, then the cut-out product photo occupying the lower ~56%. Measured identical to 4 d.p. on stick_post_gts2 and stick_post_t250; stick_post_vokey is the same with a two-line vendor lockup.

archetypes.name: Service frame — no photo, three-line headline, full-bleed teal CTA band, logo + tagline footer
archetypes.description: Solid navy field. Left-aligned white all-caps headline, 3 lines. Full-bleed teal band carries the two-line CTA. Footer row is stick logo left, tagline right. Measured identical to 4 d.p. on clubasses and swingasses; clubasses_story is the same block re-centred (+285px).

archetypes.name: Photo band — navy copy panel over a full-width photo band
archetypes.description: Navy panel fills the upper canvas; a photograph fills the lower band, full bleed. Teal all-caps headline (3 lines), white light subhead (2 lines), teal CTA. Partner logo bottom-left and stick logo bottom-right, both inside the photo band. The photo band is NOT a pure re-anchor between canvases — hence canvas_overrides.

archetypes.name: Venue / lifestyle post — full-bleed photo, navy brand plate bottom-right
archetypes.description: The photograph owns the whole canvas. A navy plate in the lower right carries the partner or venue lockup, an @ and the stick logo. Minimal type, so it is the archetype for a generated venue or lifestyle photo where the image has to carry the post. Measured on lab_post.jpg.

archetypes.name: Service start card — venue photo, navy service title, @ stick lockup, mint bar
archetypes.description: Bright venue photo full bleed. Partial white frame (6px). Large navy uppercase service word, centred @ stick lockup, mint #24FFAF accent bar (~65% width). Measured from coachingstart copy.jpg / fittingstart copy.jpg; story refs recenter via block_anchor. needs_photo true.

archetypes.name: Service end card — gradient, navy service word, @ stick lockup, mint tagline panel
archetypes.description: Light vertical gradient (#D4DEDD→#FFFFFF), partial white frame (top fade + right). Navy uppercase service word, white @ behind the navy stick wordmark, large mint #24FFAF panel carrying a service-specific tagline from the qualifier field. Measured coachingend/fittingend/equipmentend/apparelend. No photo.

archetypes.name: Service square — chevrons + decorative frame, 1:1 navy text-only (centred or split lockup)
archetypes.description: 1081×1081 square. Light blue→grey gradient field. Dark navy decorative chevrons (>>>) in one corner (top-left for lab/centred form, mirrored top-right for avoda/split lockup) and a thin navy rectangular frame at ~56px inset. Two compositional variants: lab — centred 4-line caption_hook; avoda — large UPPERCASE service word + faded @ + tail word. No photo.

archetypes.name: Location drive — short-trip map pin post, navy + green accent, locked headline
archetypes.description: Western-Cape golf-course drive posts. Styles map-photo (franschoek) and route-line (greenpoint). Locked headline A SHORT TRIP / FOR A LONG DRIVE with green accent on LONG DRIVE.

archetypes.name: Brand statement — centred mint headline, white stick logo, white rules, italic tagline
archetypes.description: Solid navy field with white stick logo top-centre, thin white rule below logo, centred mint (#24FFAF) Montserrat Black uppercase headline 4–5 lines (caption_hook split on '\n'), thin white rule above the italic 'better begins here' tagline. No photo. Used for category-list statements (FITTINGS / COACHING / EQUIPMENT / APPAREL) and brand-manifesto sentences.

archetypes.name: Coach profile — portrait, teal name band, navy credentials, stick footer
archetypes.description: Staff introduction card measured from Content Bank Stick/Other dave_post + dave_story (1080×1350 / 1080×1920). Grey-top portrait, teal name band, navy credential stack, light footer lockup. Story extends photo upward via canvas_overrides.

archetypes.name: Shop corner — full-bleed shop photo, navy corner plate, mint service-category word
archetypes.description: The photograph owns the whole canvas (shop interior/product shelf). A half-width navy gradient plate in the bottom-left carries a large mint uppercase service-category word, a white @, and the white stick wordmark, stacked. Sibling of stick-venue-post (same plate size/shape, opposite corner, no partner co-branding). Measured on Stick/Other Artboard 1 copy 2/3/4/5.jpg.
